Modeled on Biotechnica's own de-extinction work. The real animal has been back in Tasmania since the 2060s, and now you can wear its stripes, and its silent walk, through a Night City alley.

Package: Minor
Humanity Loss: 20
Includes: Exotic Bodysculpting (striped marsupial wolf), Chipware Socket w/ Olfactory Boost (permanent), Combat Jaw, Cybereye ×2 w/ LL/IR/UV ×2, Cyberleg ×2 w/ Lynx Paws and Reinforced Tendons

Install the pieces it includes as cyberware; the package price covers them all.

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
